# MOY IQ Invest — llms.txt
# https://invest.moyiq.app

MOY IQ Invest is paused since 2026-09-12. It is not accepting new users and no plans are on sale.

It was a portfolio tracking and investment risk education tool for Spanish-speaking investors. It was never a broker, did not execute orders and did not provide financial advice.

The active product of the same company is MOY IQ, a personal finance app: https://moyiq.app

Built by MAXNOVA & LUCI Global LLC.
